missing: os.urandom, secrets, uuid.uuid4 and random.SystemRandom are not deterministic under plain --det (observed only): each run prints different values and every test that uses them is reported NOT-COVERED [entropy] by the verifier. decide_against: uuid4/secrets are used for ids in ordinary tests everywhere; a default that leaves them random makes many tests 'not covered' and non-reusable; the safe default could be deterministic with an opt-out for crypto tests.
